item.title: UPS laying off 128 employees in Montgomery
item.description: UPS is laying off 128 employees in Montgomery, the company announced this week.According to an Alabama WARN List notice, the layoffs will begin on February 23.The layoffs appear to be part of UPS's nationwide downsizing.The Associated Press reported in October that UPS had cut 34,000 operational positions and closed daily operations at 93 leased and owned buildings nationwide. item.title: Brewton UPS driver recognized for heroic efforts rescuing elderly woman
item.description: A UPS driver was recognized by the Brewton City Council after delivering much more than packages before Christmas.Mayor Frank Nalty and the Brewton City Council passed a proclamation honoring Titus Drakeford for assisting an elderly resident he found wandering outside in freezing temperatures. item.title: GOP U.S. Senate hopeful Morgan Murphy: U.S. showed 'its incredible reach' with strikes against ISIS in Nigeria
item.description: Friday, during an appearance on Fox Business Network's "Kudlow," Republican U.S. Senate candidate Morgan Murphy reacted to U.S. air strikes against ISIS in Nigeria.President Donald Trump announced the strikes on Thursday. Murphy applauded the action, noting that the strikes showed the U.S. military's extraordinary reach.
